NEW evidence-bounded concept generated, targeted-edited and reviewed. Exactly three labeled supported birds; rufous dark-eyed adults remain near-equal in standing height with only subtle female fullness. The age-unknown dependent fledgling retains formed wings but has browner, shorter/rounder, softer wing feathers with diffuse flecks and gray-speckled underparts. Exact age, iris chronology, continuous feather sequence, flight threshold, nest geometry and quantified sex ratio remain unknown.

NEW evidence-bounded concept generated, targeted-edited and reviewed. Exactly three labeled supported birds in a riverine old-growth scene; massive ear-tufted adults share plumage, with the female only fuller/heavier rather than implausibly taller. The documented approximately 50-day cavity nestling keeps formed but shorter/rounder/softer folded wings, abundant smoke-gray mesoptile, a dark-mask direction, short tail and full cavity support. Exact 50-day flight ability, continuous juvenile chronology, universal sex-size ratio and subspecies/individual palette remain unknown.

Canonical correction: revision of existing #12, not a new species. NEW evidence-bounded concept generated and reviewed after two edits. Adults are tiny, round-headed and tuftless with orange-yellow eyes, black bills, streaked pale underparts and spotted brown upperparts; female is only modestly fuller. The supported late cavity nestling has coffee-brown downy mesoptile, pale X/Y face and a short rounded developing wing with reduced adult spot rows. Exact age, flight threshold, continuous feather sequence, universal sex ratio and cavity geometry remain unknown.

Canonical correction: revision of existing #09, not a new species. NEW evidence-bounded western North American hypugaea concept. Adults are small, tuftless, yellow-eyed and long-legged beside a natural burrow; their displayed size is near-equal because Mikkola and Cornell conflict. The supported 29-day prefledgling has soft mesoptile and a shortened rounded developing wing after one edit. Exact flight threshold, universal fledging timing, sex ratio and day-specific soft-part color remain unknown.

Canonical correction: revision of existing #04, not a new species. NEW evidence-bounded western European nominate-context concept. Adults are small, flat-headed, tuftless and yellow-eyed with pale brows, brown spotted upperparts and streaked pale underparts; displayed sex size is near-equal because biometrics overlap. The supported 27-day cavity-threshold chick remains downy and pre-fledging, with a shortened rounded developing wing after one edit. Exact day-by-day plumage, iris change, flight threshold and regional/subspecies variation remain unknown.

REVISION evidence-bounded nominate light-morph concept.
